name: BACO LBX10510 22 mm one-hole control station, emergency stop: 40 mm red mushroom head, push-turn to reset, maintained, 1 NC
model_source: BACO products site CAD download (TraceParts, STEP AP214, CATIA V5 export 2009-04-28), fetched 2026-10-12
model_note: 26 solids: base, cover, 4 cover screws + 4 nuts, bezel, operator body, 40 mm head, contact block, terminals; lbx10510.txt is the TraceParts attribute sheet. Bounding box 74.0 x 73.75 x 74.0. The operator axis sits 5 mm off the box centre (as modelled by BACO). Froggy v9 (2026-10-12, S2.10 option A) uses the complete station, all 26 solids, recessed through a 76 x 76 front panel opening with the yellow cover face 5 mm proud, turned 90 deg so the knockouts face +-X, on the printed fp9_estop_cradle (ICD S2.10).
author: BACO Controls, Inc. (manufacturer model via TraceParts; Nema Supply listing, SKU LBX10510)
licence: manufacturer CAD download for design use (TraceParts terms)
price_note: Nema Supply regular price, fetched 2026-10-12; the lab already has one

datasheet.enclosure: LBX single position base 74 x 74, 47.9 deep box, head 25.7 proud (BACO LBX0100 drawing, catalog p. 100)
datasheet.mounting_holes: 2 through slots 4.56 wide x 3 long in the base back, diagonal, 42.5 (X) x 59.5 (Z) apart, read off the STEP base solid: viewed from the front, top-left at (-20.5, +29.0) slot vertical, bottom-right at (+22.0, -30.5) slot horizontal, relative to the box centre; matches the LBX0100 drawing (16.5 from the left edge, 8 from the top). The other diagonal has two closed knockout bosses, not holes
datasheet.cable_entry: M16/20 knockouts in the top and bottom walls; no hole in the back
datasheet.ingress: IP69K per the Nema Supply listing title (BACO LBX listings elsewhere say IP66)
